entities.name: Henri de La Tour d'Auvergne, Duke of Bouillon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri de La Tour d'Auvergne, duc de Bouillon, was a member of the powerful House of La Tour d'Auvergne, the Prince of Sedan and a marshal of France. He was a prominent Huguenot figure.
